commands.name: Get UMS Status
commands.description: Returns UMS server status, version, and build information.

commands.name: Get Firmware
commands.description: Lists all firmware versions registered in UMS. Pass Id to get a specific version.

commands.name: Get Devices
commands.description: Lists devices. Pass Id for a single device. Filter: short (default) | details | online | shadow | deviceattributes | networkadapters.

commands.name: Start Device (Wake-on-LAN)
commands.description: Sends a wake-on-LAN command to a device. Requires device Id.

commands.name: Stop Device
commands.description: Shuts down a device. Requires device Id.

commands.name: Restart Device
commands.description: Restarts a device. Requires device Id.

commands.name: Send Device Settings
commands.description: Pushes current profile settings to a device immediately. Requires device Id.

commands.name: Update Device
commands.description: Updates device metadata (Name, Site, Department, CostCenter, Comment, AssetId). Requires device Id.

commands.name: Move Device
commands.description: Moves a device to a different directory. Requires device Id and destination directory DestId.

commands.name: Remove Device
commands.description: Deletes a device from UMS. Requires device Id. Cannot be undone.

commands.name: Reset Device to Factory Defaults
commands.description: Resets a device to factory defaults (2FA reset). Requires device Id. Cannot be undone.

commands.name: Get Device Directories
commands.description: Lists device directories. Pass Id for a specific directory. Filter: children to include child elements.

commands.name: New Device Directory
commands.description: Creates a new device directory. Requires Name.

commands.name: Rename Device Directory
commands.description: Renames a device directory. Requires directory Id and new Name.

commands.name: Move Device Directory
commands.description: Moves a device directory into another parent directory. Requires directory Id and destination DestId.

commands.name: Remove Device Directory
commands.description: Deletes a device directory. Requires directory Id. The directory must be empty.

commands.name: Get Profiles
commands.description: Lists all profiles registered in UMS. Pass Id for a specific profile.

commands.name: Rename Profile
commands.description: Renames a profile. Requires profile Id and new Name.

commands.name: Move Profile
commands.description: Moves a profile to a different profile directory. Requires profile Id and destination directory DestId.

commands.name: Remove Profile
commands.description: Deletes a profile from UMS. Requires profile Id. Cannot be undone.

commands.name: Get Profile Directories
commands.description: Lists profile directories. Pass Id for a specific directory. Filter: children to include child elements.

commands.name: New Profile Directory
commands.description: Creates a new profile directory. Requires Name.

commands.name: Rename Profile Directory
commands.description: Renames a profile directory. Requires directory Id and new Name.

commands.name: Move Profile Directory
commands.description: Moves a profile directory into another parent directory. Requires directory Id and destination DestId.

commands.name: Remove Profile Directory
commands.description: Deletes a profile directory. Requires directory Id. The directory must be empty.

commands.name: Get Device Assignments
commands.description: Lists all profiles currently assigned to a specific device. Requires device Id.

commands.name: Get Device Directory Assignments
commands.description: Lists all profiles assigned to a device directory. Requires directory Id.

commands.name: Get Profile Assignments
commands.description: Lists all devices and directories that a profile is assigned to. Requires profile Id.

commands.name: Assign Profile
commands.description: Assigns a profile to a device or device directory. Id = profile Id. ReceiverId = target device or directory Id. ReceiverType = tc or tcdirectory.

commands.name: Remove Profile Assignment
commands.description: Removes a profile assignment from a device or device directory. Id = profile Id. ReceiverId = target Id. ReceiverType = tc or tcdirectory.
